# Task 061: XML Schema 1.0 (2004) §§3.2.8, 3.2.7.1, 4.3.6 and Appendix D.
# Independent lexical oracle, not output of any production scanner.
# ss=60 with arbitrary fraction is lexical; ss=61 is not. hh=24 requires
# minute=second=fraction=0. Canonicalization is deliberately NOT performed.
